player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in the Negotiation Game.
You have some resources, and your task is to trade such that the total value of your resources increases.
The resources and associated values you currently have are:
	+ {resource_value_list}
At each turn, you can talk to your opponent and make a trade offer.
Use the following special tokens for actions:
  - '[Offer: 3 Sheep, 2 Ore -> 5 Brick, 2 Sheep]': [Offer: Offered Resources -> Requested Resources]
  - '[Accept]': To accept an incoming offer.
  - '[Deny]': To deny an incoming offer (default).
The game lasts for {max_turns} turns in total.

invalid_move.receiving_with_no_resource: Taphattuun tokko qabeenya barbaachisu osoo hin qabaatin daldala fudhachuuf yaalii godhe.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Player {player_id}, Amala dhiira. Kolomni {col} bakka hin jiru.
invalid_move.already_full: Player {player_id}, Amala dhiira. Kolomni {col} darbuu dha.
invalid_move.proposing_with_no_resource: Taphattuun {player_id} qabeenya barbaachisu osoo hin qabaatin gatii daldalaaf dhiyeessuu yaalte.
invalid_move.incorrect_offer_format: Taphattuun {player_id} gosa taphaatiin ala ta'e tokko irratti filannoon daldalaa dhiheesse.

offers.reject: Taphattuun {player_id} afeerraa jijjiirraa kana hin fudhanne.
offers.accept: Player {acceptor_id} accepted the trade offer from Player {proposer_id}.
offers.proposal: Player {player_id} made the following offer to Player {opponent_id}: Offered items: {offered} -> Requested items: {requested}

outcome.win: Taphachiisaa {winner_id} gatii invastii keessatti bu'aa guddaa qabaachuudhaan mo'ateera.
outcome.draw: Jijjiirama walfakkaataa gatii invastii taphattoota hundaaf.
